public_write_policy: anonymous intake and verified PayPal webhooks only; no privileged action, payout, deployment, publication or agent execution directly from request

implementation.turnstile: commercial-runtime/src/worker.mjs::verifyTurnstile uses fixed Cloudflare Siteverify endpoint and server-only secret
implementation.schema: commercial-runtime/src/validation.mjs rejects unknown fields and invalid service IDs
implementation.authz: project intake is intentionally public; admin approval requires Bearer token; payment webhook must verify PayPal signature
implementation.csrf: no cookie/session credentials accepted; exact Origin match when Origin is present
implementation.secrets: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY is an environment secret; never serialized to responses
implementation.idempotency: Idempotency-Key required; unique D1 constraint; deterministic replay response
implementation.audit: correlation_id plus immutable-style evidence event inserted in same D1 batch
implementation.ssrf: only server egress in intake is a compile-time constant Turnstile Siteverify URL
implementation.durability: D1 transactional batch writes project + evidence + dispatch outbox before asynchronous workflow dispatch
implementation.payments: verified PayPal webhooks write payment_events plus payment_ledger in REQUIRES_HUMAN; no automatic PAID transition
implementation.approvals: admin approval endpoint records approval_events and can promote only policy status, not payment, deployment or ACTIVE state

promotion_blockers: PROJECT_WORKFLOW binding/Nexus policy workflow not deployed
PayPal webhook deployed credentials and webhook ID not provisioned
payment-provider-to-project matching and quote reconciliation not fully automated
production SLO and alert evidence not collected
